summary: Phase 2 backend tests: all 32/32 pytest cases pass. Covered: (1) GET /api/users/{id}/public snapshot (fields present, no auth required, 404 on unknown); (2) POST /api/upload real Emergent object-storage upload (image success, .svg rejected 400, >12MB rejected 400, no-auth 401); (3) GET /api/files/{id} download via ?auth= query and Authorization Bearer, admin bypass, 401 no-auth, 403 unrelated user, 404 unknown; (4) POST /api/ai/listing-suggest with image_base64 AND image_url — verifies GPT-5.4 vision returns all required keys (title/description/category_slug/category_id/category_name/condition/brand/color/size/suggested_price_usd), category_slug coerced against DB slugs, category_id populated, 400 when neither field provided; (5) shipping labels — seller creates MOCK... tracking, idempotent 2nd call, non-seller 403, tracking has_label:false before label, events timeline w/ label_created first + current_status = last event, dev_mock:true, buyer can view, unrelated user 403; (6) seller/apply with id_document_file_id — upload → verify email/phone → apply → application persists file id and is returned by GET /api/seller/application; (7) regression: login, listings, categories, cart, favorites, orders, admin/stats (pending_seller_apps), chat/threads, auth/me. Real 400x400 JPEG (picsum) used for AI + upload tests per image_testing.md.

minor.issue: payout_method literal is 'stripe_connect' or 'bank_transfer', but the frontend/UI likely sends 'bank' or 'stripe' — worth double-checking the SellerApply.jsx form maps to the exact literals to avoid 500s on submit. (Backend correctly returns Pydantic 500 today; ideally a 422.)
Referenced in some contexts but no such route exists — /api/auth/me currently carries verification flags. Confirm the frontend doesn't call /api/verify/status.

action_items: Verify SellerApply.jsx sends payout_method values that match backend Literal: 'stripe_connect' | 'bank_transfer'. Pydantic ValidationError currently surfaces as 500 (should be 422 for user input).
Notification on seller-approval still deep-links to /verify (carried over from Phase 1) — link to /profile or /seller once approved.
server.py is now 2307 lines — split into routers/modules (auth, listings, seller, verify, stripe, admin, storage, ai, shipping).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 2307 lines; exceeds the 700-line guideline. Split into modular routers to keep maintainable.

seller_apply raises Pydantic ValidationError as 500 instead of returning 422 — wrap payout_method conversion or let FastAPI's request-body validation catch this by validating payout_method inside SellerApplicationCreate rather than at SellerApplication instantiation.

/api/files/{file_id} uses `?auth=` query parameter — tokens in query strings get logged in access logs/proxies. Prefer Authorization header or short-lived signed URLs; if the query fallback must stay for usage, add a note and consider expiring signed tokens.
Storage helpers put_object/get_object are synchronous _requests calls inside async endpoints — will block the FastAPI event loop under load. Wrap in asyncio.to_thread() or use httpx.AsyncClient.
_extract_json regex uses greedy `\{.*\}` — good for GPT outputs today but will silently accept partial responses. Fine for mock/dev; harden later.
shipping tracking timeline is derived purely from order.created_at — no persisted events, so real integrations won't drop in cleanly. Consider persisting an events array on the order.
get_public_user returns 'email_verified' etc but not the literal 'email' — matches spec (safe), just documenting intentional omission for reviewers.

Upload accepts up to 12MB and reads the entire body into memory before size check — an attacker can still tie up worker memory pre-check. Enforce Content-Length pre-check or stream with a rolling byte cap.
AI endpoint blocks per-request on LlmChat.send_message with no rate limiting — add per-user throttling before production.
